steps.message: In Simple Calendar Pro, delete all events scheduled for this Friday.

Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; settings get global device_name 2>/dev/null; pm list packages | grep -i 'simple\|calendar' ; echo '---CALENDARS---'; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/calendars --projection _id,name,calendar_displayName,visible,sync_events 2>/dev/null | head -n 20; echo '---EVENTS---'; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/events --projection _id,title,dtstart,dtend,deleted --where \"deleted=0\" 2>/dev/null | head -n 20"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; settings get global device_name 2>/dev/null; pm list packages | grep -i 'simple\|calendar' ; echo '---CALENDARS---'; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/calendars --projection _id,name,calendar_displayName,visible,sync_events 2>/dev/null | head -n 20; echo '---EVENTS---'; content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/events --projection _id,title,dtstart,dtend,deleted --where \"deleted=0\" 2>/dev/null | head -n 20""
